patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — InboxAlly and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose InboxAlly only if your buying job matches “Email deliverability and reputation repair via seed engagement and inbox placement tooling” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than InboxAlly's shape. Workflow advantage: InboxAlly leans ecommerce-email; Mailjet leans newsletters, lead-nurturing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — InboxAlly and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: InboxAlly is Email deliverability and reputation repair via seed engagement and inbox placement tooling.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: InboxAlly (small-business, mid-market) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: InboxAlly-leaning ecommerce-email vs Mailjet-leaning newsletters, lead-nurturing, marketing-automation.
- Researched limits: InboxAlly — Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — InboxAlly: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP; Pricing scales steeply with sender profiles and seed volume; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: InboxAlly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid InboxAlly if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
